description: Whatever be the occasion, bridal showers, birthday, Christmas, housewarming, or Mother's Day, nothing can compete a tasty cake to make such an occasion more special. A beautiful custom cake pan will act just like the cherry on a cake. Our personalized cake pan is ideal for potlucks and bake sales which allows you to personalize it with your message or name. You are free to showcase your own creativity. This is not the end. Our cake pans offer kitchen utensils that can be used on regular basis as well. That's My Pan! Traditional personalized, aluminum 9x13" cake pan with lid is a heavy gauge, American made pan and lid. The pan has a large, rolled edge that acts as a convenient handle for removal from the oven. The lid has it's opening tab on the long side of the pan.
